scripts.launch:audition: for t in keynote cinematic garage; do remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/rebase-launch.mp4 -i public/launch/music-$t.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k -shortest out/rebase-launch-$t.mp4; done
scripts.launch: node scripts/compose-launch-music.mjs && remotion render RebaseLaunch out/rebase-launch-4k.mp4 --scale=2 && remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/rebase-launch-4k.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 14 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy out/rebase-launch.mp4
scripts.reel: remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Plausible out/reel-plausible.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Fanout out/reel-fanout.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-TwoUsers out/reel-twousers.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Included out/reel-included.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Refused out/reel-refused.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Drift out/reel-drift.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Push out/reel-push.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Stream out/reel-stream.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Map out/reel-map.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Matrix out/reel-matrix.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Reel-Routes out/reel-routes.mp4
